left.source: script Root version "1.0.0"; entity E { state x: Int = 1 + 1; on start { return; } }

right.source: script Root version "1.0.0"; entity E { state x: Int = 2; on start { return; } }

left.source: script Root version "1.0.0"; fn twice(x: Int) -> Int = x + x; entity E { state out: Int = 0; on update { out = twice(2); } }

right.source: script Root version "1.0.0"; fn twice(value: Int) -> Int = value + value; entity E { state out: Int = 0; on update { out = twice(2); } }

left.source: script Root version "1.0.0"; entity E { state out: Int = 0; on pulse(x: Int) { let temp = x + 1; out = temp; } }

right.source: script Root version "1.0.0"; entity E { state out: Int = 0; on pulse(value: Int) { let calculated = value + 1; out = calculated; } }

left.source: script Root version "1.0.0"; entity E { state sum: Int = 0; state value: Option<Int> = Some(2); on start { for i in 0 .. 2 { sum = sum + i; } match value { Some(x) => { sum = sum + x; } None => { return; } } } }

right.source: script Root version "1.0.0"; entity E { state sum: Int = 0; state value: Option<Int> = Some(2); on start { for index in 0 .. 2 { sum = sum + index; } match value { Some(payload) => { sum = sum + payload; } None => { return; } } } }

left.source: script Root version "1.0.0"; record R { z: Int; a: Rat; } entity E { state z: Int = 1; state a: Rat = 2; on start { return; } }

right.source: script Root version "1.0.0"; record R { a: Rat; z: Int; } entity E { state a: Rat = 2; state z: Int = 1; on start { return; } }

left.source: script Root version "1.0.0"; behavior A { on update { log "A"; } } behavior B { on update { log "B"; } } entity E { use A; use B; on start { return; } }

right.source: script Root version "1.0.0"; behavior A { on update { log "A"; } } behavior B { on update { log "B"; } } entity E { use B; use A; on start { return; } }

left.source: script Root version "1.0.0"; entity E { on update { log "A"; log "B"; } }

right.source: script Root version "1.0.0"; entity E { on update { log "B"; log "A"; } }

left.source: script Root version "1.0.0"; fn f(x: Int) -> Int = x + 1; entity E { state out: Int = 0; on update { out = f(2); } }

right.source: script Root version "1.0.0"; fn f(x: Int) -> Int = x * 1; entity E { state out: Int = 0; on update { out = f(2); } }

left.source: script Root version "1.0.0"; capability sensor.read() -> Int observation; entity E { state out: Int = 0; on update { out = sensor.read(); } }

right.source: script Root version "1.0.0"; capability sensor.read() -> Rat observation; entity E { state out: Rat = 0; on update { out = sensor.read(); } }
